case.title: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH. Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation. Need: 23400 pc a year. Category goal: secure supply of a bottleneck part: coverage of the full need and a supplier that stays healthy come first. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 42 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: volume_per_year >= 22230. Prepare from the data package.

move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Monika Zellner,

thank you for your offer and for the reliable cooperation. We would like to settle this in a way that works for both sides. We can commit for the longer term, which gives you planning security: 36 months. Our bottom-up estimate of the full cost is EUR 24.31 per unit before margin (cost:340010). On that basis we propose EUR 24.72 per unit, a 36-month contract, 23,400 units per year, a lead time of 42 days.

Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your message, which we have processed.
This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.
Our terms: a price of €33.80 per unit, Lieferzeit 42 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months.
For the record:
We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We note your cost estimate; however, our specialized manufacturing and high capacity utilization dictate our pricing structure.
We can accommodate the 36-month term and the increased volume of 23,400 units to support your planning security.
To manage this volume reliably, we must maintain the lead time at 54 days, which allows us to offer a revised price of EUR 31.90 per unit.
Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.
Our Lieferzeit is 42 days.
These are our standard conditions for this product.
We will process your next message according to our standard procedure.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
